```artifact
Feature: Alarms in GUI

  Scenario: Compute VTE for each breath
    Given the GUI is open
    When the VTE for the current breath is calculated
    Then the VTE value should be displayed

  Scenario: Compute "HIGH VTE" alarm
    Given the GUI is open
    And the VTE for the current breath is above the threshold
    When the VTE is calculated
    Then a "HIGH VTE" alarm should be triggered
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: Compute "LOW VTE" alarm
    Given the GUI is open
    And the VTE for the current breath is below the threshold
    When the VTE is calculated
    Then a "LOW VTE" alarm should be triggered
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: Display all currently active alarms
    Given the GUI is open
    And multiple alarms are active
    When the alarms are displayed
    Then all active alarms should be shown

  Scenario: Log confirmed alarm settings
    Given the GUI is open
    And an alarm is confirmed
    When the alarm is logged
    Then the alarm settings should be included in the event log

  Scenario Outline: Compute VTE with different values
    Given the GUI is open
    And the VTE for the current breath is <vte_value>
    When the VTE is calculated
    Then the VTE value should be <expected_vte>

    Examples:
      | vte_value | expected_vte |
      | 10        | 10           |
      | 20        | 20           |
      | 30        | 30           |

  Scenario Outline: Compute "HIGH VTE" alarm with different values
    Given the GUI is open
    And the VTE for the current breath is <vte_value>
    When the VTE is calculated
    Then a "HIGH VTE" alarm should be triggered if <vte_value> is above the threshold
    And the alarm should be of medium priority if <vte_value> is above the threshold

    Examples:
      | vte_value | threshold | expected_alarm |
      | 10        | 15        | no             |
      | 20        | 15        | yes            |
      | 30        | 15        | yes            |

  Scenario Outline: Compute "LOW VTE" alarm with different values
    Given the GUI is open
    And the VTE for the current breath is <vte_value>
    When the VTE is calculated
    Then a "LOW VTE" alarm should be triggered if <vte_value> is below the threshold
    And the alarm should be of medium priority if <vte_value> is below the threshold

    Examples:
      | vte_value | threshold | expected_alarm |
      | 10        | 5         | yes            |
      | 20        | 5         | yes            |
      | 30        | 5         | no             |

  Scenario: High-priority alarm when O2 input line is disconnected
    Given the GUI is open
    And the O2 input line is disconnected
    When the alarm is triggered
    Then a high-priority alarm should be triggered
    And the alarm should be displayed

  Scenario: Pressure high alarm cooldown
    Given the GUI is open
    And the "pressure high" alarm is triggered
    When the alarm is cancelled
    Then the "pressure high" alarm should not re-trigger for 2 minutes
```
